derivation: Offline PGlite replay of the shipped chain (billing settlement and the refund follow-up withheld), then the exact migration; re-derived by tests/db/repeatTipPostflight.integration.test.ts.

triggers.name: trg_prec_att_guard_tip
triggers.definition: CREATE TRIGGER trg_prec_att_guard_tip BEFORE UPDATE ON public.progress_recommendation_attempts FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION _prec_att_guard_tip()

triggers.name: trg_prec_att_snapshot_tip
triggers.definition: CREATE TRIGGER trg_prec_att_snapshot_tip BEFORE INSERT ON public.progress_recommendation_attempts FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION _prec_att_snapshot_tip()

triggers.name: trg_sessions_prec_tip_on_completed
triggers.definition: CREATE TRIGGER trg_sessions_prec_tip_on_completed AFTER INSERT OR UPDATE OF status ON public.sessions FOR EACH ROW WHEN ((new.status = 'completed'::text)) EXECUTE FUNCTION _prec_att_on_session_completed()

triggers.name: trg_sessions_purge_practised_tip_on_expire
triggers.definition: CREATE TRIGGER trg_sessions_purge_practised_tip_on_expire AFTER UPDATE OF transcript_state ON public.sessions FOR EACH ROW WHEN (((new.transcript_state = 'expired'::text) AND (old.transcript_state IS DISTINCT FROM 'expired'::text))) EXECUTE FUNCTION _prec_att_purge_tip_on_expire()

constraints: prec_att_practised_tip_shape c CHECK (((practised_tip IS NULL) OR (((char_length(practised_tip) >= 1) AND (char_length(practised_tip) <= 4000)) AND (btrim(practised_tip) = practised_tip))))
progress_recommendation_attempts_tip_session_id_fkey f FOREIGN KEY (tip_session_id) REFERENCES sessions(id) ON DELETE SET NULL
indexes: CREATE INDEX idx_prec_att_tip_session ON public.progress_recommendation_attempts USING btree (tip_session_id) WHERE (tip_session_id IS NOT NULL)
